descriptionChirho: The abstract notion of secrecy or covertness, typically used adverbially with preposition beth (בַּסֵּתֶר 'in secret, secretly') to describe clandestine or hidden action.

A concrete or semi-concrete place of concealment, refuge, or protective covering, often in construct with a following genitive (סֵתֶר פָּנֶיךָ 'the shelter of your presence') or with possessive suffixes, denoting a location of safety or divine protection.
